C0353.title: Talent Outreach Disguised as Illegal Credential Stuffing: Nationwide Registered Architects Targeted
C0353.summary: Between 2023 and 2024, Zhuli Company used crawlers to scrape public data and then performed credential stuffing attacks against a specific app using obtained ID numbers, in an attempt to complete private information such as phone numbers. The company illegally obtained and sold over 3.8 million pieces of citizens' personal information, making an illicit profit of 73,600 yuan.
